SPLIT_CLIENT_SDK_API_KEY.description: Split calls it a special type of API token with limited privileges for use in browsers or mobile clients, which is the whole basis for publishing it. Now part of Harness FME.

SPLIT_SERVER_SDK_API_KEY.description: Scoped to back end services. Split gives it no secrecy sentence of its own, but the browser carve-out above is written for the other key, which is what leaves this one on the server.

SPLIT_ADMIN_API_KEY.description: For management rather than evaluation. Harness says these keys carry many privileges and not to store them in publicly accessible places. Rotating replaces the value under the same named key.
